title: A community radio broadcast and its highlights
titleZh: 社區電台直播與精華節目
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — RIVER BANK RADIO | Listener bulletin

Our Saturday programme, Voices by the River, is live from 4 to 5 p.m. The sound from the studio will go out on both FM and the website. The website does not let listeners go back to an earlier point during the live broadcast.

We release a highlights programme on Tuesday. It contains selected interview extracts, not a repeat of the entire hour. For music performed live in the studio, the programme lists the song titles instead of including a recording. A short announcement from the presenter may be added separately if a planned segment is moved.

The monthly bulletin goes to print in advance. If a guest arrives late, the host can change the order without changing the broadcast start time. The online running order shows the current plan.

DOCUMENT 2 — MESSAGE FROM THE HOST | Saturday, 3:35 p.m.

A bus breakdown has delayed our guest Ren Ito. We will begin at the usual time with the short interview about the river ferry. The Hill Steps Trio will then perform two songs live in the studio. Ren will join us at about 4:40 to talk about the floating gardens, instead of opening the programme as the bulletin says.

The web team has already changed today's running order. There is still a link to last Tuesday's highlights below it. It is correctly dated and has nothing to do with today's delay, so please leave it in place. For this Tuesday's highlights, I plan to include an extract from Ren's interview. I will also record a short announcement explaining why Ren did not open the programme.
passageZh:
文件一 — 河岸電台｜聽眾公告

我們週六的節目《河畔之聲》在下午四點到五點直播。錄音室的聲音會透過 FM 廣播和網站同步播出。節目直播時，網站無法讓聽眾回到較早的播出時間點。

我們會在週二推出精華節目，內容是節選的訪談片段，而不是重播完整的一小時。錄音室現場演奏的音樂在精華中只會列出曲名，不會放演奏錄音。若有預定的段落更動，主持人可能會另外加錄一段簡短說明。

紙本月刊會提前付印。若來賓遲到，主持人可以調整順序，不必更改直播開始時間。網站上的節目流程反映目前的安排。

文件二 — 主持人訊息｜週六下午 3:35

公車故障耽誤了來賓 Ren Ito。我們照原定時間開播，先進行河上渡輪的短訪談。接著山階三重奏會在錄音室現場演奏兩首歌。Ren 大約下午 4:40 加入我們，談談水上花園，不會像月刊所寫的那樣為節目開場。

網站團隊已更新今天的節目流程。流程下方仍有上週二精華節目的連結。它的日期正確，與今天的延誤無關，請保留在原處。至於本週二的精華節目，我已決定會節錄 Ren 的訪談。我也會錄一段簡短說明，解釋 Ren 為何沒有為節目開場。
